audienceResearch.note: Budgets, mandates, horizons, and constraints are deliberate research hypotheses, not claims about Cryptonary customers. Every allocation is hypothetical and must cite only visible product evidence.

compare crypto, stock, yield, and prediction ideas

audienceSegments.name: professional and high-net-worth allocators
audienceSegments.evidence: Operator explicitly wants investors who are genuinely interested in distributing capital.
jobs: triangulate research, market regime, and portfolio construction
document an investable thesis and rejection criteria
assumptions: Budgets from $1.5 million to $10 million test institutional-depth expectations without implying actual customer assets.

ideaRules.idea: Show how every proposed position changes portfolio concentration, drawdown, liquidity, and time-horizon risk.
Connect each research thesis to explicit catalysts, invalidation conditions, time horizon, and a portfolio role.
Explain how regime indicators should change position sizing rather than only displaying a directional signal.
Show source, duration, liquidity, counterparty, smart-contract, and token-price risks beside every yield figure.
Show implied probability, resolution rules, liquidity, and maximum loss before presenting a prediction as investable.
Separate educational opportunity discovery from wallet-connection or claim actions, with explicit security warnings.
Tie paid plan value to concrete investor workflows and evidence depth, not only content volume.

confidenceRules.high: Repeated across at least four budgets and supported by screenshots from at least three distinct product surfaces.
confidenceRules.medium: Repeated across at least two budgets or supported by one strong cross-surface journey.
confidenceRules.low: Single-persona reaction, taste judgment, or finding affected by blocked traffic or environment uncertainty.
